title: Research: sharp nine-coordinate threshold for five-subset shared nodes (seed 48)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A doubly degenerate shared node with constant-weight-five labels first admits the historical orthonormal-residual interface at **nine coordinates**. The proof excludes h<8 using PR920's floor and excludes h=8 by a complement isometry to the triple class in PR1139. An explicit h9 witness provides all four orthonormal residual bases, with dimensions **3,3,4,4**.

**Status: structural research note; no new kappa or paid supplier.** Only research/five-subset-shared-node-seed48/ is added. Global label coverage, simultaneous frames, source access, helpers, copies/restoration, recursive pricing, hosting and analytic/precision obligations remain open.

## Task and overlap

Seed48 (fresh OS draw), structural decoder track. Exact base: ce7ad1b6ab09452c3478723a2e96ed5ff212dc08. Scope key: five-subset / doubly-degenerate / signed-rank-one / disjoint-spans / h8-h9 / orthonormal-residuals. CLAIM.json records three candidate tasks, the local claim, complete domain and stopping rule.

Nearest predecessor: @woklerx's #1139, pinned at 82da1e827c51d94691134c6aec346357d89622bc, proves the triple-only ten-coordinate classification. This changes the label alphabet and adds a sharp weight-five threshold and exact census. It does not lower PR920's unrestricted norm-one h8 floor. PR920 (@ArnavSwiggy), historical head 913817423bbfaf241dec1d6b9edb1c7ded349508, supplies the residual criterion and four-plus-four bound. No pending implementation is imported.

Open PR metadata refreshed through #1171, with no matching five-subset package. CONTRIBUTING/autoresearch guidance changed during the sprint; the new discussion board was checked before submission (only its three starter threads, no overlapping claims). The explicit seed48 assignment and fixed base are retained.

## Validation

Python3.9.6, standard library, offline:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/five-subset-shared-node-seed48/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/five-subset-shared-node-seed48/independent.py
```

Both pass normally and with -O. The independent labeled set census agrees on **0 rectangles at h8 and 453,600 at h9**. The canonical frame enumeration tests all **59,520** dimension-four candidates; every canonical rectangle has exactly **48** legal frames. Both implementations independently check the witness residual spans and Gram entries.

Six mathematical controls, all 65,536 h8 isometry vector pairs, all 3,136 complement-kernel pairs, optimized relocation, six malformed-certificate rejection exits, source pins, selected-record guard and staged whitespace check pass. Final read-only review caught and verified the fix for a missing-basis cardinality check. The written threshold proof and finite census are distinct evidence.

No repository-wide or selected cold supplier replay was run for this isolated historical geometry package. No hosted CI success or formal multiplication theorem proof is claimed. Selected frontier and upstream/ remain unchanged.

## Credit

Credit Douglas Colkitt's historical parity kernel/obstruction, @ArnavSwiggy's #920, @woklerx's #1139 and the seed47 frame-completion note. Exact sources are pinned in SOURCES.json. Prepared for **@ToikY** with substantial **OpenAI Codex** assistance in mathematics, implementation, independent algorithms and review. Apache-2.0. No independent human peer review claimed.
